q: On at least one day from November 1, 2026, through March 31, 2027, the settlement price of the front-month Dutch TTF natural gas contract (not the intraday price) exceeds €100 per megawatt-hour
basis: On October 9, EU gas storage was 73.5 percent full, 16.9 percentage points below the five-year average, and disruptions to Qatari LNG supplies are continuing. If stocks drain faster during the January–February peak in winter demand, prices are likely to break €100. The forecast tracks how the Iran war is feeding into European households' heating bills and consumer prices.
rs: ICE Endex settlement prices (or settlement prices reported by Reuters if ICE data are not accessible)
